title: Site search index page
description: One successfully parsed page in the site-scoped search index.

domain.description: Hostname used for the domain-scoped index.

title.description: Page title from metadata or document title.

description.description: Description from Schema.org, Open Graph, or standard metadata.

content.description: Bounded readable page text; empty when disabled or unavailable.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash used for incremental comparison.

sourceType.description: Discovery source: start-url, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, or sitemap.

structuredData.description: Schema.org JSON-LD objects found on the page.

indexedAt.description: ISO timestamp when this page was indexed.
